location: near Manas International Airport, Bishkek, Kyrgyz Republic
source_publisher: Interstate Aviation Committee (IAC/MAK), Air Accident Investigation Commission
decision_reason: IAC identifies the destroyed ACT Airlines Boeing 747-412F TC-MCL, serial 32897, as a fatal accident and records 39 fatalities; the accident involved a commercial cargo operation with crew and ground fatalities.

reconciliation_evidence.observation: IATA reports six fatal commercial-airline accidents in 2017: five turboprop accidents and one cargo-jet fatal accident; 35 ground fatalities and 12 of 19 onboard fatalities involved cargo aircraft. Its accident table identifies TC-MCL as the Boeing 747-400 cargo hull loss at Bishkek.

reconciliation_evidence.publisher: Boeing Commercial Airplanes, reported by Flight Safety Foundation
reconciliation_evidence.record: 2017 worldwide commercial-jet accident statistics / ACT Airlines 747-400
reconciliation_evidence.observation: Boeing's worldwide commercial-jet data identify the ACT Airlines 747-400 as the sole 2017 accident with onboard fatalities, with 4 onboard and 35 external fatalities.
